verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird has a documented Patents practice group page offering "strategic patent advice," delivered by a team that includes lawyers with scientific and engineering backgrounds. That loosely covers portfolio strategy, but nothing in the evidence documents drafting, prosecuting or filing patent applications, and the UPC accolade concerns litigation, not prosecution. Missing for 10: explicit patent drafting/prosecution/filing services, named patent practitioners, documented portfolio-building methodology, independent corroboration of a prosecution practice.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: At Bird & Bird, we offer strategic patent advice rooted in deep sector knowledge, technical expertise, and extensive cross-border experience. Our team includes lawyers with scientific and engineering backgrounds
